editorial:
Picture your favorite Parisian superheroes trading croissants for hot dogs as Marinette and her classmates land in New York City for French-American Friendship Week. The city that never sleeps is also the city of superheroes, and that means Ladybug and Cat Noir are about to meet some new allies. But Hawk Moth has followed them across the Atlantic, bringing his akumatized chaos to the Big Apple. The vibe is bright, energetic, and packed with the kind of colorful action that makes you want to grab popcorn and settle in with the whole family.

The animation looks crisp and the action scenes move fast, though younger viewers might find a few moments a little intense. The voice acting keeps things lively, and the crossover with American heroes adds fresh energy to the Miraculous formula. It is not perfect, since the plot rushes in places, but it delivers plenty of heart and humor. If you are a fan of the series or just want a fun animated adventure, this is a great pick.
endingExplained: In the final battle, Ladybug and Cat Noir team up with the American heroes to stop Hawk Moth and his akumatized villain. After a tense showdown across New York landmarks, the heroes manage to purify the akuma and restore peace. The twist comes when Marinette realizes the true identity of one of the American heroes, adding a new layer to her secret life. The movie ends with the class celebrating friendship week, hinting that more adventures await across the globe.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves animated superhero adventures and family-friendly action.
